name: Antitoxin Touch
levelText: alchemist 1, druid 1, hunter 1, investigator 1, ranger 1, shaman 1, witch 1
componentsText: V, S, M (a small drop of antitoxin)
description: The target’s skin secretes a small amount of venom-resistant oils for the spell’s duration. The target cannot accidentally poison itself while applying poison. Additionally, the target does not risk exposure to a creature’s poison when attempting to milk venom (Ultimate Wilderness 142).
